QUOTE: `ExternalBridge::run_async_ask` spawns `std::thread(...).detach()` per `entropic.ask` (`external_bridge.cpp:1158-1222`). The thread captures `this` and `handle_`, and nothing joins it.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer identifies the async-ask worker as the detached thread with no join that outlives the bridge/caller, which is the substance of the item.
